summary: Compare a baseline and candidate Codex skill on repeatable routing and behavior cases before deciding whether to adopt it.

scenarios.title: Gate a proposed skill rewrite
scenarios.prompt: Use $evaluate-skill-change with this baseline, candidate, and case file. Tell me whether the candidate should be adopted.
scenarios.outcome: An accept, reject, or needs-review decision based on identical cases, held-out coverage, validation, and regressions.

scenarios.title: Check a trigger change
scenarios.prompt: Use $evaluate-skill-change to compare these skill descriptions for routing precision without installing either candidate.
scenarios.outcome: Comparable routing and behavior evidence with the live skill left untouched and no automatic adoption.
